title: Genesis App Templates: Clone Living Apps, Not Static Shells (2026)
summary: Clone Taskade Genesis app templates across 8 categories, ops, productivity, finance, marketing, and more. Each is a live app with AI agents and automations.
body_markdown:
Yes. Once you customize a clone, you can publish it on a custom domain with[built-in sign-in](https://www.taskade.com/wiki/genesis/custom-domains) so clients log in to a branded portal. Custom domains and sign-in are available on Business plans and above.


---


**Stop starting from a blank screen.**[Browse cloneable apps](https://www.taskade.com/apps) ,[clone the closest template](https://www.taskade.com/create) , and reshape it by describing what you want. Explore more in the[AI agents library](https://www.taskade.com/agents) , the[automation hub](https://www.taskade.com/automate) , or the[Genesis app builder wiki](https://www.taskade.com/wiki/genesis/app-builder) .


▲ ■ ● Memory, Intelligence, Execution, clone an app and you inherit all three. The database remembers, the agents reason, and the automations run. That is the difference between a template you fill in and an app you ship.
